About this item

  • Quality Visuals: The KG271U 27" IPS monitor with 2560 x 1440 QHD resolution in a 16:9 aspect ratio presents stunning, high-quality images with excellent detail. The zero-frame design does away with the thick frames found on conventional monitors freeing up precious screen space.
  • AMD FreeSync Technology: Say “goodbye” to stuttering and tearing. With AMD FreeSync, the monitor’s frames are synced with the graphics card’s frames, which eliminates screen tearing and provide the smoothest gaming experience.
  • Up to 180Hz: The 180Hz refresh rate speeds up the frames per second to deliver an ultra-smooth 2D motion scene. With a rapid refresh rate of up to 180Hz, Acer Gaming Monitors shorten the time it takes for frame rendering, lower input lag and provide gamers an excellent in-game experience.
  • Responsive!!: Up to 0.5ms GTG (Gray to Gray) response time enhanced gamers’ in-game experience. No matter the fast-moving action or any dramatic transitions will be all rendered smoothly without the annoying effects of smearing or ghosting with KG271U Gaming Monitor.
  • New Depths of Color Accuracy: is monitor is ideal for color-critical projects producing accurate colors, supporting DCI-P3 95%. An amazing monitor for graphic designers, photographers, and film editors.

Product Description

The Gate of Smooth Gaming: In competitive gaming, every frame matters. Introducing Acer's KG271U gaming monitor - the QHD (2560 x 1440) resolution monitor that can keep up with your game play. This AMD FreeSync monitor takes gameplay to the next level of smooth, the game’s frame rate is determined by your graphics card, not the fixed refresh rate of the monitor, giving you a serious competitive edge. Plus, users can enjoy comfortable viewing experience while gaming via flicker-less, low dimming and ComfyView display. The design saves space on your desk and lets you place multiple monitors side by side to build a seamless big-screen display. (UM.HX1AA.307)

    How customer reviews and ratings work

    Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

    To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    super smooth, saturated colors, and great display!
    this monitor was a HUGE upgrade for me. going from a 24”, 1080p res, 70hz refresh to this beauty was absolutely game changing. it comes with a displayport in box, but you can use an hdmi as well! i’ve had great results from using the displayport though. the movement is smooth and the colors show beautifully! it really makes my (in progress) desk setup pop <3 the only thing i notice is that the built-in speakers quality isn’t the best, but since i have my own speakers i’ve been using this isn’t a problem for me! i only tested with music, so if you’re looking for great music speakers i’d check other options or get external speakers! otherwise, it’s a great upgrade for me! :)

      4 out of 5 stars
      Amazing Monitor! The Stand? Not So Much.
      Reviewed in the United States on August 7, 2025
      Size: 27-inchStyle: WQHD 180Hz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This monitor works great and getting it on sale made it even better. 1440p is all you will ever need especially for console gaming. It runs up to 180hz on display port but hdmi it can reach 120hz easily allowing you to maximize your response time for your console and give yourself more time to react. You can quickly switch between different modes for different games and even create user specific modes that you can adjust to your hearts desire. All of the display settings are easily adjustable through the analog button on the rear of the monitor. Also the monitor has settings that can actively adjust your picture for different situations in games (I currently cannot recall the term for it). You can adjust the brightness, saturation, and more. One of my favorite features is the different display presets such as low blue light that can help when working late on the monitor. My only demerit of the monitor is the stand itself is kind of flimsy and is not adjustable. I would advise getting a mount for your monitor of some sort if you are to purchase this monitor. Otherwise this is an amazing monitor I got for an amazing price during Prime Day Deals.

      5 out of 5 stars
      Love it with an asterisk
      Reviewed in the United States on April 12, 2025
      Size: 27-inchStyle: WQHD 180Hz
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This is a review after 3 months of usage, spoiler alert, I’m pretty happy with it.*

      I bought this 27inch 1440p 180Hz (KG271U N3bmiipx) monitor for around 170 usd with offer and taxes.

      Pros:

      1. 2K, very fast 180hz refresh rate, with built in speakers for 170 USD.

      2. Pretty high color range (DCI-P3 95%), not verified, but to naked eye, love the vivid colour accurate display, this was important to me.

      3. IPS screen, meaning good viewing angles, also important for good viewing experience.

      4. Decent HDR for an IPS LCD budget monitor.

      5. Didn't notice any flickering.

      Reasons for asterisk:

      1. In standard or other modes, even when set to 100, brightness feels low in well lit environments. Turning HDR mode on solves this issue, probably because of increased peak brightness, but this makes it too bright in dark environments, you won't be able to adjust screen brightness in HDR mode. Switching between standard and HDR mode felt a little tedious.

      2. Overshooting is noticeable to naked eye if overdrive setting is set as extreme. Recommend setting it to minimum, or off, then it’s not at all noticeable.

      3. Speakers are like what you’d expect in your typical gaming monitors. Pretty mediocre, will get the job done. They lack any base or instrument clarity or separation. In movies or songs, vocals are pretty crisp, but the background music sounds pretty low. Could be solved with headphones or speakers.

      4. HDMI connections only supports upto 144hz.

      5. Lack of height adjustment for stand.

      6. Felt like a thick monitor, build quality is decent, all plastic, does not give you premium feels, but good for it's price.

      At this point you might be thinking, why did this guy give 5 stars when the cons list is bigger than pros. It's because I compared this with similarly priced Sansui ESA-G27F6Q and Arzopa M1RC side by side, and overall Acer seemed like the best pick in this price range.

      Reviewed in the United States on June 27, 2026

      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I have owned several Acer monitors over the years. My office has four of them. Acer continues to be a reliable member of my systems team.

      The Nitro 27 has replaced an older model which I broke by putting too much stress on the HDMI port(s). Because of this, I have added two short HDMI male to female connectors to prevent this issue from reoccurring.

      I've never had a monitor with this level of screen resolution. It is so crisp I don't need to enlarge the fonts so I get far more information on the screen. Setup took a couple of retries, but the system figured it out pretty much on its own.

      BUT: When I first tried to get help from the Acer support site, it was down. I tried hours later and it was still down. However, when I tried the next day, it worked fine. Stuff happens.
